money.title: Money

money.notAccountingNote: This is a lightweight record-keeping tool, not full accounting software. It won't file your taxes. Export the CSV for your accountant when you need a proper set of books.

referrals.subtitle: Share your code. When a friend registers their business and pays, you both get credit toward your Deevale GH fees.

wizard.title: Start your business
wizard.subtitle: Six quick steps - your progress is saved as you go.

business.reservedTitle: This sector is reserved for Ghanaian citizens.
business.reservedBody: Under Ghana's investment law (GIPC Act), {{sector}} is not open to foreign participation. Please choose a different sector, or continue with wholly Ghanaian ownership.
business.employeesLabel: How many employees do you plan to hire in year one?
business.employeesHint: Used to plan your SSNIT employer registration. 0 is fine.

ownership.heading: Owners & directors
ownership.intro: A company limited by shares needs at least one director and one shareholder (can be the same person). Include yourself if you're an owner.
ownership.foreignTinNote: Non-Ghanaian parties need a non-citizen TIN - we'll obtain it from GRA using these passport details.
ownership.sharesNote: You can refine shareholding percentages with your case officer later.
